description: Pure data layer for Cumulative Recall: extend the store to schema v4 (completedAt timestamps + recall done-tracking), stamp completedAt on first completion, and add two pure modules — the recall scheduler (recall.ts, read-only) and the cross-note stratified sampler (recall-sample.ts). This is a self-contained, buildable/typecheckable unit with no UI. FEAT-002 depends on it.
steps: src/lib/store.ts — Bump SCHEMA_VERSION from 3 to 4. Add three fields to the StoreDoc interface: completedAt: Record<string, number>, recallWeeklyDone: number[], recallMonthlyDone: number (with detailed JSDoc matching the file's style; note that undated legacy completions — routes in progress[] but absent from completedAt — are intentional and appear only in monthly/all sweeps).

src/lib/store.ts — Seed the three new fields in emptyDoc() ({}, [], 0). Deep-copy them in cloneDoc() ({ ...doc.completedAt }, [...doc.recallWeeklyDone], and pass the number through). Add coercers next to toReviewRecord/toAttemptRecord: toNumberRecord(v) returning Record<string,number> of finite-number values only, and toNumberArray(v) returning finite numbers only. Salvage all three in migrate() (use toNumberRecord(raw.completedAt), toNumberArray(raw.recallWeeklyDone), num(raw.recallMonthlyDone, 0)). In save(), add them to the clean object: completedAt passed through, recallWeeklyDone deduped with [...new Set(...)], recallMonthlyDone passed through.

src/lib/progress.ts — In markDone(), inside the update() callback's not-already-present branch, also write completedAt: { ...doc.completedAt, [key]: Date.now() }. Do NOT overwrite an existing timestamp (the early-return when already present already guarantees this). Add a one-line comment explaining the stamp-once rule. Leave markUndone/toggleDone/resetProgress untouched regarding completedAt.

src/lib/recall.ts — NEW pure, read-only module (import load + onStoreChange from ./store; may import DAY_MS from ./review or define a local DAY_MS). Normalize routes the same way the other facades do when reading completedAt keys. Add a nowMs() helper (Date.now()). Export: WeeklyCycle interface { cycleEnd: number; routes: string[] }; pendingWeeklies(now = nowMs()): WeeklyCycle[] — anchor = earliest non-zero completedAt value; fixed 7-day cycles [anchor + k*7d, anchor + (k+1)*7d); a cycle becomes a candidate once cycleEnd <= now; count dated topics in-window, and carry routes from a <3-topic window forward into the next window's threshold count until a window reaches >=3 topics (that window becomes one pending cycle keyed by its cycleEnd); exclude cycleEnds already in recallWeeklyDone; return oldest-first. isLagging(now = nowMs()): boolean — pendingWeeklies().length >= 2. MonthlyWindow interface { routes: string[] }; pendingMonthly(now = nowMs()): MonthlyWindow | null — routes with completedAt in [now-30d, now] PLUS undated completions (in progress[] not keyed in completedAt); return null unless the combined set has >=3 routes AND (recallMonthlyDone === 0 OR now - recallMonthlyDone >= 30d). onRecallChange(listener): () => void — thin wrapper over onStoreChange. Detailed header comment explaining the window model and carry-forward rule.

src/lib/recall-sample.ts — NEW pure module (import Quiz, QuizQuestion from ./quiz). Export: type SampledQuestion = QuizQuestion & { sourceRoute: string; sourceLabel: string }; interface SampleResult { questions: SampledQuestion[]; topicCount: number }; interface SampleOptions { perTopic: number; min: number; max: number }; const WEEKLY_SAMPLE: SampleOptions = { perTopic: 3, min: 6, max: 15 }; const MONTHLY_SAMPLE: SampleOptions = { perTopic: 2, min: 6, max: 24 }; function sampleRecall(routes: string[], quizzes: Map<string, Quiz>, labelFor: (route: string) => string, opts: SampleOptions, rng: () => number = Math.random): SampleResult. Logic: for each route that has a quiz, pick up to perTopic questions preferring distinct concept tags and mixing difficulty bands (uniform-with-concept-spread when over budget — no per-question history yet), tag each with sourceRoute and sourceLabel = labelFor(route); combine, interleave across topics round-robin (NOT grouped by topic), shuffle with rng, then enforce the max hard cap; never pad with duplicates to reach min; topicCount = number of routes that contributed >=1 question. No DOM/storage. Detailed header comment.
acceptance_criteria: SCHEMA_VERSION is 4 and StoreDoc has completedAt: Record<string,number>, recallWeeklyDone: number[], recallMonthlyDone: number, all seeded/cloned/migrated/saved.
markDone() stamps completedAt[key] = Date.now() exactly once per route and never overwrites an existing timestamp.
src/lib/recall.ts exports pendingWeeklies, isLagging, pendingMonthly, onRecallChange and the WeeklyCycle/MonthlyWindow types, reads the store only (no writes, no DOM).
src/lib/recall-sample.ts exports sampleRecall, SampledQuestion, SampleResult, SampleOptions, WEEKLY_SAMPLE, MONTHLY_SAMPLE and is pure.
Running `npm run typecheck` produces 0 new errors in src/.
Running `npm run build` exits 0 with 38 pages built and 30 pages indexed.

npm run build  — confirm exit 0, console shows '38 page(s) built' and pagefind 'Indexed 30 pages'
